text:
zoe.marketing: quick sync  launching two experiments next week: 1) tier label A/B, 2) calculator UX (simple vs slab). want alignment on copy, metrics, and lead routing.

sam.product: copy options: A=Flex / Committed / Enterprise, B=Starter / Growth / Enterprise. leaning Flex. will draft microcopy for both.

omar.analytics: note: historical data shows Starter depresses perceived capability. recommend primary test Flex vs Starter on hero headline. baseline conversion for simple calc = 4.1%. target slab >= 4.6%.

zoe.marketing: good. marketing will author two microcopy variants and a short benchmark blurb for the launch blog: "pricing that scales: tradeoffs between commit and unit cost".

tess.cs: CS asks: add FAQ anchor "Committed capacity & latency" and ensure calculator "contact sales" passes tier_selected so we can triage incoming asks.

sam.product: frontend spec: calculator variants: simple_estimator (single input) and slab_calculator (commit slider + tier preview). form POST will include hidden fields: lead_origin=pricing_calc, experiment=tier_calc_nov, variant=(simple|slab), tier_selected=(flex|committed|enterprise).

ian.growth: webinar CTA under calc: show email capture interstitial (email + one-line use-case). retarget sequence needs utm_experiment=tier_calc_nov and utm_campaign=pricing_launch.

omar.analytics: events to track: pricing_page_view, tier_label_click, calc_variant_exposed, calc_submit, contact_sales_click, webinar_interstitial_submit. KPIs: calc_clicks, contact_sales_clicks, sales_form_submits, 7d_MQL_rate, ARR_cohort_90d. set alert if slab delta >= 0.5pp.

zoe.marketing: two UX asks: 1) change "commit" label to "monthly commit estimate" to avoid legal connotations, 2) add small footnote: "estimates exclude taxes and infra credits" to reduce CS noise.

sam.product: noted. ENG ticket ENG-2001 raised for calc rounding/formatting bug and hidden field mapping. assigned to frontend team, P1 for rounding.

tess.cs: sales routing rule: if tier_selected=committed and monthly_estimate_tokens >= 100000 then route to enterprise AE queue, else route to SDR. also add lead tag calculator_variant for CRM.

ian.growth: analytics mapping: include experiment and variant in CRM: Campaign = pricing_launch, Source = pricing_calc, Variant = slab/simple. helps cohorting.

omar.analytics: need final event payload schema by Thu EOD so I can wire baseline dashboard. I'll publish tile and baseline by Sun.

zoe.marketing: timeline: copy + FAQ updates Thu, ENG fixes Fri, QA Sat, flip A/B Mon 09:00 PT, run 14 days. objections?

sam.product: blocking check: frontend to confirm exact event names and sales form field names by Thu noon.

deploy-bot: /deploy staging-pricing-experiments v1.0  started by zoe.marketing (CI #5123)

tess.cs: CS will add playbook snippet and link to /pricing#latency-sla.

eust: (typo correction) zoe.marketing: thanks team  I'll post the experiment brief in #growth and tag owners when we flip.
